class.name: BulletFactory2D
class.brief_description: The heart of the BlastBullets2D plugin. Use this node to spawn bullets.
class.description:
The factory does all the work in spawning bullets and configuring other plugin related options. Keep a reference of your [b]BulletFactory2D[/b] node throughout the lifetime of your game and call the functions you need.
For tutorials and usage examples: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@realnikich]YouTube Channel[/url] [url=https://github.com/nikoladevelops/godot-blast-bullets-2d]Official Repository Of BlastBullets2D[/url]
[b]This plugin is completely free and open source - created by [url=https://x.com/realNikich]realNikich[/url][/b] Support My Work [url=https://ko-fi.com/realnikich]Donate On Ko-fi[/url] [url=https://www.patreon.com/realnikich]Donate On Patreon[/url]

method.name: clear_active_bullets
method.description: Clears every live bullet with dismissal visuals: runs each active volley's [method BulletVolley2D.clear_all_bullets], so On Clear effect layers fire, and emptied volleys go back to the pool. Returns how many bullets were cleared. Pass [code]null[/code] (default) for every bucket, or a [VolleyPoolKey2D] for one exact bucket. Allowed inside collision and lifetime handlers. Unlike [method free_active_bullets] (silent deletion) and [method reset] (silent teardown), this is the wave-clear path that reads on screen.

method.name: clear_active_bullets_deferred
method.description: Deferred [method clear_active_bullets]: safe from any callback.

method.name: clear_sprite_effects
method.description: Stops every active sprite visual. Volley bakes keep their configs (triggers keep working); the manual hatch bakes are dropped entirely.

method.name: debug_advance_time
method.description: Debug/test helper: runs one factory physics step with an explicit [param delta] (hitch and zero-delta audits; the engine loop always steps at the physics rate). Returns [code]false[/code] and advances nothing while the factory is paused. A non-finite or negative delta, or a call from inside a running tick, is refused with an error.

method.name: debug_assert_no_dangling
method.description: Structural consistency check: {ok, error, volleys_total}. Verifies vec/pool/sparse-set agreement (no nulls, sparse ids match indexes, active ids live). Never mutates. For crash-suite invariants after every destructive section.

method.name: debug_check_interpolation_status
method.description: Interpolation agreement check: factory_enabled, project_enabled_2d, mismatch, hint. Enable both the factory flag and ProjectSettings physics/common/physics_interpolation for smooth high-refresh bullets.

method.name: debug_clear_effect_log
method.description: Debug/test helper: empties the effect log (recording stays on).

method.name: debug_clear_sound_log
method.description: Debug/test helper: empties the sound log (recording stays on).

method.name: debug_expected_pool_key
method.description: Derives the exact pool bucket a spawn would use without spawning. Returns null on empty data.

method.name: debug_explain_sound
method.description: Diagnosis for one entry at one pose: which gate would drop the play, with the measured numbers. Returns {audible, blocked_by (none/paused/disabled/streamless/chance_zero/amount_gate/distance/camera_view), distance, effective_max_distance, zoom, camera (pinned/viewport/none), in_camera_view, interval_open, trigger_chance, chance (always/never/rolling), listener, occluded, volume_base (deterministic mix without the random rolls), volley_amount}. Read-only except reusing the resolve paths (a bad camera_path fires its one warning); never queues candidates. When a sound stays silent, ask here first.

method.name: debug_get_active_attachments_amount
method.description: Get the amount of active [BulletAttachment2D] nodes.

method.name: debug_get_active_bullets_amount
method.description: Returns how many volleys are active (flying, not pooled and not queued for deletion). Counts volleys, not bullets: see [method get_active_bullet_count] for bullets.

method.name: debug_get_attachments_pool_amount
method.description: Get the amount of [BulletAttachment2D] inside the object pool.

method.name: debug_get_attachments_pool_info
method.description: Get the whole information about the attachment object pool. Returns a [Dictionary] containing the scene path (or [code]"<in-memory>"[/code] for unsaved scenes) as the KEY and the amount of pooled attachments from that scene as the VALUE.

method.name: debug_get_bullets_pool_amount
method.description: Returns how many disabled volleys currently wait in the object pool, across every bucket.

method.name: debug_get_bullets_pool_info
method.description: Describes the volley object pool. Returns a [Dictionary] containing [VolleyPoolKey2D] as the KEY (one per exact amount_bullets + shape bucket) and the amount of pooled multimeshes in that bucket as the VALUE.

method.name: debug_get_effect_log
method.description: Debug/test helper: the effects recorded since [method debug_set_effect_log_enabled] was turned on, oldest first, one Dictionary per effect: [code]trigger[/code] (BulletEffectLayerData2D trigger), [code]volley[/code] (instance id), [code]bullet[/code] (index), [code]position[/code] and [code]frame[/code] (physics frame).

method.name: debug_get_effect_state
method.description: One-shot manager state: effect clock, bake count, total active slots, manual-bake actives and bake count, container validity, and per-bake volley/layer/active/slots/z/visibility/light/shards_busy/live_slots rows.

method.name: debug_get_factory_state
method.description: Lifecycle snapshot: is_ready, is_busy, is_iterating, is_tearing_down, processing, volleys_total, volleys_pooled, attachments_pooled.

method.name: debug_get_graze_stats
method.description: Graze counters: refreshes (group scans by the factory's target lists, at most one per group per physics step), events_total (graze events dispatched by every volley), cached_groups (zone groups with a target list), live_detectors (graze target finders alive: the factory's plus one per spawner with its own settings, kept while its bullets fly).

method.name: debug_get_graze_targets
method.description: The graze targets of [param group] exactly as the next volley tick of this physics step tests them: an Array of {id, position} (every live [Node2D] member in tree order, in this factory's World2D; no cap).

method.name: debug_get_live_volley_ids
method.description: Instance ids of active volleys owned by a spawner. For teardown tests.

method.name: debug_get_pool_bucket
method.description: Live pool bucket (amount + shape) of one volley, for per-bucket free/reset assertions in multi-spawner tests. Returns null on null input.

method.name: debug_get_pool_hit_stats
method.description: Pool reuse counters (64-bit): hits, misses. A spawn from inside a volley's own collision handler never reuses that volley (it is mid-tick), so it is served by another pooled instance or a fresh allocation and still succeeds. A 0% hit rate with a pre-populated pool means the spawn key never matches (e.g. helper_skip_indices shrank transforms after populate); compare [method debug_expected_pool_key] against [method debug_get_bullets_pool_info] keys.

method.name: debug_get_sound_log
method.description: Test helper: every sound the mixer played while recording was on, as {sound, position, frame} dicts (oldest dropped past 4096 entries).

method.name: debug_get_sound_stats
method.description: Sound mixer counters: {voices_total, voices_busy, channels, pending, plays_total, dropped_total}. Sample twice and subtract for per-frame rates.

method.name: debug_get_sound_voices
method.description: One dict per voice pool slot: {index, busy, fading, sound, priority, position, volume_db, pitch_scale, bus, stream, max_distance, attenuation, panning_strength, area_mask, paused}. Feed it to your own Node2D _draw loop for a live voice overlay (circle per busy voice at position, radius by volume_db).

method.name: debug_get_total_attachments_amount
method.description: Get the total amount of [BulletAttachment2D] in the scene tree.

method.name: debug_get_total_bullets_amount
method.description: Returns how many volleys the factory tracks (active and pooled).

method.name: debug_reset_pool_stats
method.description: Resets the pool hit/miss counters from [method debug_get_pool_hit_stats].

method.name: debug_set_effect_log_enabled
method.description: Debug/test helper: when enabled, every one-shot effect the factory fires is recorded for [method debug_get_effect_log]. Off by default; turning it off clears the log. The log keeps the newest 4096 entries.

method.name: debug_set_graze_slab_min_targets
method.description: Test/profiling hook: zones with more live targets than [param value] (default 8) test each bullet only against the targets near its motion in x instead of every target (same results, far cheaper with many targets). 0 = always, a huge value = never. Process-wide. Returns the previous value; a value outside 0..64 pushes an error and changes nothing.

method.name: debug_seed_cosmetic_rng
method.description: Test helper: reseeds the plugin's cosmetic generator, which draws sound mix rolls (volume, pitch, pan, stream picks, chance) and effect layer starts, scales and rotations. Godot's [method @GlobalScope.seed] does not reach these rolls, so gameplay randomness stays the same whatever the audio does.

method.name: debug_set_sound_log_enabled
method.description: Test helper: records every played sound while on (cleared when switched off). One bool check per play.

method.name: debug_stop_sound_voices
method.description: Debug/test helper: stops every voice at once (channels kept).

method.name: debug_validate_spawn_data
method.description: Non-mutating validation: {ok, error, warning}. Never spawns, never touches the pool. The warning fires for invisible bullets (no sprite_frames/mesh/texture_size); art must face Vector2.RIGHT (cannot be auto-detected).

method.name: ensure_factory_initialized
method.description: Lazy recovery for a GDScript _ready() that skipped super._ready(): builds missing containers/debuggers and returns whether the factory is ready. Called automatically by every spawn/populate entry; call it manually after _ready if you override _ready in a script (better: call super._ready() first). Warns once when recovery runs.

method.name: free_active_bullets
method.description: Frees active bullets in the scene tree. Pass [code]null[/code] (default) to free all, or a [VolleyPoolKey2D] to free only that exact amount_bullets + shape bucket. Refused during the physics step (for example inside collision handlers); call it deferred then. Warning (shared factories): this frees live volleys from EVERY spawner using this factory (or bucket), not just yours.

method.name: free_active_bullets_deferred
method.description: Deferred [method free_active_bullets]: safe from any callback. Use this instead of free() on volleys inside handlers (free() mid-sweep corrupts iteration; queue_free() via [method free_volley_deferred] is the single-volley equivalent).

method.name: free_attachments_pool
method.description: Completely frees the [BulletAttachment2D] object pool. To free only the attachments that came from one scene, use [method free_attachments_pool_for_scene].

method.name: free_attachments_pool_deferred
method.description: Deferred [method free_attachments_pool]: safe from any callback.

method.name: free_attachments_pool_for_scene
method.description: Frees only the pooled [BulletAttachment2D] attachments that came from the given scene.

method.name: free_attachments_pool_for_scene_deferred
method.description: Deferred [method free_attachments_pool_for_scene]: safe from any callback.

method.name: free_bullets_pool
method.description: Frees pooled (disabled) volleys. Pass [code]null[/code] (default) to free the whole pool, or a [VolleyPoolKey2D] to free only that exact amount_bullets + shape bucket. Example: [code]VolleyPoolKey2D.make(200, PhysicsServer2D.SHAPE_CIRCLE)[/code]. Refused during the physics step; call it deferred then.

method.name: free_bullets_pool_deferred
method.description: Deferred [method free_bullets_pool]: safe from any callback.

method.name: free_disabled_bullets
method.description: Frees disabled (pooled) bullets. Pass [code]null[/code] (default) to free all, or a [VolleyPoolKey2D] to free only that exact amount_bullets + shape bucket. Refused during the physics step; call it deferred then.

method.name: free_disabled_bullets_deferred
method.description: Deferred [method free_disabled_bullets]: safe from any callback.

method.name: free_volley_deferred
method.description: Safe single-volley free from any callback: uses queue_free(), never free()/force_delete(). Use this inside area_entered and other handlers instead of freeing the volley directly. Only bullet volleys ([BulletVolley2D]) are accepted; any other node is rejected with an error and left alone.

method.name: get_active_bullet_count
method.description: Live bullets across every active volley, summed from each volley's live counter: O(active volleys), no per-bullet scan. Counts bullets, unlike [method debug_get_active_bullets_amount], which counts volleys.

method.name: get_active_effect_count
method.description: Total live one-shot effect slots across all bakes (plus the manual hatch).

method.name: get_frame_stats
method.description: Cheap, always-on profiling snapshot. Keys: [code]physics_ticks[/code], [code]physics_tick_usec[/code] (last tick), [code]peak_physics_tick_usec[/code], [code]render_usec[/code] (last interpolation pass, 0 when interpolation is off), [code]volleys_ticked[/code] and [code]bullets_ticked[/code] (last tick), [code]collision_records_total[/code], [code]expired_bullets_total[/code], [code]spawned_bullets_total[/code], [code]pool_hits[/code], [code]pool_misses[/code], [code]active_bullets[/code], [code]active_volleys[/code], [code]pooled_volleys[/code], [code]active_effects[/code], [code]active_attachments[/code]. [code]physics_ticks[/code] and the [code]*_total[/code] counters are cumulative since start (or the last [method reset_frame_stats]): sample twice and subtract for per-frame rates. The same numbers are graphed live in the editor's Debugger > Monitors tab, see [member register_performance_monitors].

method.name: get_is_factory_busy
method.description: Sometimes the [b]BulletFactory2D[/b] might be busy doing some important work. This property provides an easy way to check if that's true.

method.name: get_is_tearing_down
method.description: Returns true once the factory started destroying itself. While true, teardown paths stop touching child nodes and most factory operations report an error instead of running.

method.name: get_physics_space
method.description: Get the physics world space in which the bullets interact.

method.name: play_sound
method.description: Manual sound hatch: plays [param sound] at [param global_position] at the end of the next sweep (Godot listener, or the nearest member of [param listener_group]). Returns false when refused (null, disabled, outside the tree, paused, editor): offers made during a sweep play at the end of that sweep.

method.name: populate_attachments_pool
method.description: Populates the attachments object pool. Ensure that the [code]attachment_scene[/code] contains an actual [BulletAttachment2D] scene where you attach other nodes - particles or anything else you could think of. Pooling is keyed by the scene itself, so every loader of the same scene shares one pool bucket.

method.name: populate_attachments_pool_deferred
method.description: Deferred twin of [method populate_attachments_pool]: queued on the factory's idle structural queue, so it is safe to call from collision and lifetime handlers (where structural calls are rejected).

method.name: populate_bullets_pool
method.description: Pre-creates [code]instance_count[/code] disabled volleys in one exact bucket. [code]key.amount_bullets[/code] is bullets per volley (must equal [code]spawn_data[/code] transforms size); [code]instance_count[/code] is how many volleys to create. The [code]key[/code] is required and must match the bucket derived from [code]spawn_data[/code] (amount_bullets + effective collision shape); mismatch aborts with an error and creates nothing. Example: [code]populate_bullets_pool(VolleyPoolKey2D.make(5, PhysicsServer2D.SHAPE_CIRCLE), data, 2)[/code] creates 2 volleys of 5 bullets each.

method.name: populate_bullets_pool_deferred
method.description: Deferred [method populate_bullets_pool]: safe from any callback. Null key, null data and instance_count <= 0 are rejected immediately without queuing.

method.name: reactivate_volley
method.description: Puts a pooled volley back into the set of volleys the factory moves every tick, after one of its bullets was woken with [method BulletVolley2D.enable_bullet] outside of a normal spawn. Does nothing when the volley is already active, when the factory is busy, or when the factory is tearing down. You normally never call this yourself: [method BulletVolley2D.enable_bullet] already does it.

method.name: reset
method.description: Resets the factory. Pass [code]null[/code] (default) for a full reset (all bullets, pools, and the full attachment pool). Pass a [VolleyPoolKey2D] to reset only that exact amount_bullets+shape bucket; unrelated pooled attachments are preserved. Refused during the physics step; call it deferred then. Warning (shared factories): this kills live volleys from EVERY spawner using this factory (or every spawner sharing the bucket, when keyed) - not just yours. Spawner trackers prune the dead ids on next read. Emits the [signal reset_finished] signal when complete.

method.name: reset_deferred
method.description: Deferred [method reset]: safe from collision, lifetime, timer and spawner-signal handlers. Validates cheaply now, runs the real op after the physics step.

method.name: reset_frame_stats
method.description: Resets the peak tick time, [code]physics_ticks[/code] and the cumulative [code]*_total[/code] counters of [method get_frame_stats]. Pool hit/miss counters are separate: see [method debug_reset_pool_stats].

method.name: set_physics_space
method.description: Sets the world physics space that the bullets interact in. Set it before spawning: it applies to subsequently spawned bullets, already spawned areas stay in their space. Invalid RIDs are rejected with an error.

method.name: set_use_physics_interpolation_runtime
method.description: Controls whether physics interpolation is enabled or not for all bullets controlled by the [b]BulletFactory2D[/b]. This method is supposed to be called during runtime, while the [method set_use_physics_interpolation_editor] method is supposed to be called in the editor.

method.name: spawn_layer_effect
method.description: Manual one-shot hatch: plays any layer once at a global pose, owned by the factory (survives volleys). Distinct layers coexist (up to 8 manual bakes, oldest dropped). Returns the slot index, or -1 when the layer is inert.

method.name: spawn_volley
method.description: Spawns one volley: one bullet per entry of [member BulletVolleyData2D.transforms], each flying along its transform's rotation. A pooled volley of the same bucket (bullet count + collision shape) is reused when one exists. Returns the live [BulletVolley2D], or [code]null[/code] when the request was refused (the error says why). Ignore the return value for fire-and-forget bullets; keep it to steer the volley at runtime (homing, curves, attachments, teleporting, timers...). [param inherited_velocity_offset] is added to every bullet's velocity (recoil, moving shooters). Leave [param spawner_id] at 0: [BulletSpawner2D] uses it to own the volley's signals. Example: [code]var volley := factory.spawn_volley(data)[/code] Warning: with auto pooling on (the default) an expired volley returns to the pool and a later spawn may hand out the same object again. If you store volleys in your own arrays, set [member BulletVolley2D.is_auto_pooling_enabled] to false on them.

method.name: stop_sounds
method.description: Stops every voice at once (channels kept). reset() also forgets the channels.

method.name: teleport_shift_all_bullets
method.description: Shifts all bullets in the scene by a certain amount (only bullets spawned by this particular [b]BulletFactory2D[/b]). Every [BulletVolley2D] volley is moved, with shape, attachment and interpolation state synced per bullet. Warning (shared factories): this moves EVERY spawner's live volleys at once - there is no per-spawner or per-bucket variant.

members.member: The color of the debug collision shapes drawn for every volley while [member is_debugger_enabled] is on. Can be set before the factory enters the tree (it applies on ready).
When false, pooled/frozen volleys are hidden in the debugger instead of drawn frozen. Default true preserves always-draw behavior.
Max debugger providers drawn per tick (0 = unlimited). Beyond the cap extra volleys are hidden, oldest first. Lower this on 10k-bullet demos where the always-draw debugger costs frames.
Whether the debugger of the collision shapes is enabled or not.

Use this if you want to pause processing of bullets - being able to stop bullets in place. Always use this instead of [code]set_process[/code]/[code]set_physics_process[/code]. While paused nothing is drained. Overlaps that START during the pause are parked per volley (bounded at 4096 records, deduplicated, cancelled when the overlap ends before resume) and replayed exactly once on resume. Overlaps counted before the pause are never re-reported, and nothing piles up into a resume hitch. Warning (shared factories): pausing stops EVERY spawner's bullets at once - there is no per-spawner pause.

When on (default), the factory registers custom monitors on ready, graphed while the game runs in the editor's Debugger > Monitors tab: BlastBullets2D/Active Bullets, Active Volleys, Pooled Volleys, Physics Tick (ms), Peak Physics Tick (ms), Interpolation (ms), Active Effects and Active Attachments. Use them to spot which frames are heavy and what causes it. One factory owns the monitor ids at a time (the first to become ready; others skip silently, and a freed owner's ids are reclaimed). Runtime only, never in the editor; removed when the factory leaves the tree.

Voice pool size for the whole factory: one AudioStreamPlayer2D per simultaneous sound. Voices are created on demand; past this a new event steals the oldest voice of equal or lower priority, never a more important one. The pool only grows to its high-water mark: lowering the cap later never frees existing voices.

Determines whether physics interpolation is enabled or not. The setter is for the editor only.
Instead always use [method set_use_physics_interpolation_runtime] if you are doing changes during runtime.

signal.name: area_entered
signal.description:
Emitted live, inside the physics tick, when a bullet enters an [Area2D]; only for factory-owned volleys (a spawner's volleys emit on the spawner). The bullet is still alive in the handler, with every runtime property readable: [method BulletVolley2D.bullet_get_custom_data], [method BulletVolley2D.get_bullet_global_transform] (the impact pose), [method BulletVolley2D.get_bullet_velocity], [method BulletVolley2D.get_bullet_collision_count] (this hit is already counted) and the attachment.
After the handler returns, the plugin decides: if the hit count is still at [member BulletVolley2D.bullet_max_collision_count] the bullet dies (On Destroy effects at the impact pose), otherwise it lives on (On Hit). A handler may veto the kill by lowering the count, disable the bullet itself (no extra effects), free its target (later hits on it are skipped) or pause the factory (the remaining hits wait for the resume). Structural calls ([method reset], [code]free_*[/code], [code]populate_*[/code]) are rejected here: use their [code]*_deferred[/code] twins. Per-bullet edits and spawning apply immediately.

signal.name: body_entered
signal.description:
Emitted live, inside the physics tick, when a bullet hits a physics body; same contract as [signal area_entered].
Note: Static bodies are only detected when [member BulletVolleyData2D.monitorable] is [code]true[/code] (it costs performance, so prefer areas or other body types for enemies and buildings).

signal.name: bounce_area_entered
signal.description: Emitted live when a bullet bounces off an area (the area's layer matches the bounce mask). The reflection is already applied: the handler reads the new velocity and [method BulletVolley2D.bullet_get_bounce_count]. Same handler contract as [signal area_entered]. A bounce that also consumes the hit ([member BulletVolleyData2D.bounce_hit_consumed]) emits this signal first, then [signal area_entered] (unless the handler disabled the bullet).

signal.name: bounce_body_entered
signal.description: Emitted live when a bullet bounces off a body; same contract as [signal bounce_area_entered].

signal.name: bullet_graze_exited
signal.description: Emitted live when a bullet that grazed a zone leaves it alive (outside the outermost ring of every target of the zone). [param deepest_ring_index] is the smallest-radius ring touched during that visit and [param target] the target the visit belonged to (null for a point target: [constant BulletSpawner2D.GRAZE_SOURCE_MOUSE], [constant BulletSpawner2D.GRAZE_SOURCE_GLOBAL_POSITIONS]). A bullet killed, cleared, expired or frozen inside never exits. Every exit reaches the factory (right after the owner spawner's own signal).

signal.name: bullet_grazed
signal.description: Emitted live, inside the physics tick right after the bullets moved, when a bullet comes within ring [param ring_index] of [param zone] around [param target] (see [BulletGrazeZone2D]). [param target] is null when the target is a point (a spawner's Mouse or Global Positions source). The bullet is alive in the handler: transforms, velocity and custom data are readable and writable through [param volley]. Several rings entered in one tick fire from the largest radius to the smallest. Every graze in the game reaches the factory whoever owns the volley (the owner [BulletSpawner2D] emits first while it lives), including bullets of spawners already freed: connect here once to count graze for score. Structural calls need their [code]_deferred[/code] twins inside the handler.

signal.name: life_time_over
signal.description: Emitted live, inside the physics tick, when bullets of a volley reach the end of their lifetime, only if [member BulletVolleyData2D.is_life_time_over_signal_enabled] is on. [param bullet_indexes] lists the expiring bullets, still alive in the handler (custom data, transforms and attachments readable). After the handler, every listed bullet still alive dies with its On Lifetime Over effects, unless the handler extended its life ([method BulletVolley2D.set_life_time_left]) or made the volley infinite. Spawning from the handler is fine; structural calls need their [code]*_deferred[/code] twins.

signal.name: reset_finished
signal.description: Emitted once after an accepted [method reset] (full or scoped) or [method reset_deferred] has completed and the factory is processing again, so a handler can spawn the next wave right away. A rejected reset emits nothing.
